_comment: SKILL 51 / FIX 29 - SECRETS-STORE ROTATION RECORD TEMPLATE for the
signature-presentation turn-ledger HMAC key. This file is a SHAPE
reference and provisioning runbook only. Provision the REAL record in
the secrets store (never in this repo, never in logs or proof
artifacts). The verifier reads it from the path in
PRESENTATION_SP_TURN_LEDGER_KEYS_FILE (canonical) or the discrete
PRESENTATION_SP_TURN_LEDGER_* environment variables.
FIELD NOTES
current_key / previous_key : raw UTF-8 key strings. GENERATED, never
shared between clients or environments.
rotation_started_at        : ISO-8601 UTC instant rotation began
(persisted - the 14 x 24 h migration
window is measured from THIS instant).
previous_key_expires_at    : optional; defaults to
rotation_started_at + 14 x 24 h. At this
instant old-key verification FAILS
CLOSED automatically.
PROVISIONING RUNBOOK (operator only; values NEVER committed anywhere)
1. Generate current + previous keys (e.g. openssl rand -base64 32).
2. Write the record to the secrets store with a fresh key_id pair
(IDs are safe to log; key VALUES never are).
3. Start signers (deck-intake-driver.py and its materialized
role-library copy) - they pick up the CURRENT key automatically
and stamp its key_id + signed_at into every envelope. A signer
NEVER signs with the previous key.
4. During the 14-day window the verifier accepts current + previous;
every old-key acceptance writes an audit event (key_id + envelope
timestamp, no key bytes) and bumps old_key_acceptance_count().
5. At previous_key_expires_at old-key verification stops and fails
closed. After recording the cutoff proof, REMOVE previous_key
(and its id) from the store.
6. Rotation complete iff: all active signers stamp the current id AND
the verifier's old-key acceptance count reached zero before the
cutoff.
CONFIG FAILURE = FAIL CLOSED: missing current key, unknown key_id,
absent signed_at, or a rotation clock moving backward is a
launch/configuration failure (AF-SP-INTAKE-UNPACED 'configuration
failure'). Nothing in this system degrades open on key trouble.
current_key: <SECRET - LIVE ONLY IN THE SECRETS STORE>
